name: Net Ball
text: Your attacks deal 5% more damage to Bug- and Water-type foes.

name: Charcoal
text: Fire-type moves deal 10% more damage.

name: Mystic Water
text: Water-type moves deal 10% more damage.

name: Miracle Seed
text: Grass-type moves deal 10% more damage.

name: Muscle Band
text: Physical moves deal 6% more damage.

name: Wise Glasses
text: Special moves deal 6% more damage.

name: Seed Surge
text: At the end of a battle, your Grass-type Pokémon heal 1 HP.

name: Hot Meal
text: Right away: heal every Pokémon 50%. Fainted ones get up with 25%.

name: Revival Herb
text: Right away: every fainted Pokémon gets back up with 50% HP.

name: Sturdy Shell
text: Take 5% less damage. Stacks up to 4 times.

name: Leftovers
text: After each round, your most hurt Pokémon heals 1 HP.

name: Bright Powder
text: Your Pokémon dodge attacks 5% more often.

text: +10% Tickets from battles. Stacks.

name: Pay Day
text: Each foe you knock out drops 1 extra Ticket.

name: Stamina Snack
text: Battles start with +10 Stamina for each Pokémon. Stacks.

name: Cram Notes
text: The attack timing bar moves 10% slower.

name: Lucky Egg
text: +15% EXP from battles. Stacks.

name: Supply Drop
text: Right away: get 2 random battle items.

name: X Attack
text: All attacks deal 5% more damage for the rest of the run. Stacks.

name: Quick Claw
text: Fast moves deal 10% more damage.

name: Rocky Helmet
text: Foes that hit your Pokémon take 1 damage back.

name: Expert Belt
text: Super-effective hits deal 15% more damage.

name: First Strike
text: Each Pokémon’s first attack in a battle deals 25% more damage.

name: Tender Love and Care
text: Revived Pokémon get up with 4 more HP. Stacks (+4 each).

name: Guard Up
text: Guarding blocks 10% more damage.

name: Eviolite
text: Pokémon that can still evolve take 8% less damage.

name: Protective Pads
text: Take 10% less damage from physical moves.

name: Assault Vest
text: Take 10% less damage from special moves.

text: Boss battles give double Tickets.

name: Haggler

name: Fury
text: +10% damage for each fainted Pokémon on your team.

name: Life Orb
text: Attacks deal 20% more damage but cost the attacker 1 HP (never below 1).

name: Scope Lens
text: The critical-hit zone on the timing bar is 50% wider.

name: Focus Sash
text: Once per battle, a Pokémon at full HP survives a knockout hit with 1 HP.

name: Shell Bell
text: Attacks heal the attacker 8% of the damage dealt (at least 1).

name: Frenzy
text: Extra damage beyond what a knockout needed turns into Tickets.

name: Quick Ball
text: Foes skip their first turn in every battle.

name: Thief
text: 25% chance after each battle to snatch a random item.

name: Choice Band
text: Charged attacks deal 25% more damage.

name: Second Wind
text: Once per run, when your whole team faints, everyone gets back up with 30% HP.

name: Golden Ticket
text: +40% Tickets, and shop prices are 25% lower.

name: Card Shark
text: Card picks show 4 cards, and cards of 3★ or more show up twice as often.

name: Ultra Burst
text: Attacks after a first-try correct answer deal 40% more damage.

name: Sacred Ash
text: After every battle, fainted Pokémon get up with 50% HP and everyone heals 10%.
